title: Assumption
text: Constrain signal values when proving model properties, 1 input, 1 output; {Enable} sets the whether block is enabled, {Type} sets the whether the block behaves as a Proof Assumption or Test Condition, {Values} sets the proof Assumption, {Display values} displays the contents of values parameter and {Pass through style(show Outport)} sets the whether block displays an output port in the Simulink. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal specified as a scalar or cell array scalar | cell array
